items.headline: Chip and AI stocks suffer their worst day since the 2020 crash as US data-center opposition hardens
items.why: The selloff reprices the AI build-out as a political and permitting risk, not just a demand story, which puts the capital-spending trajectory of every large buyer of chips in question.

items.headline: Microsoft declines an option to more than double its Texas AI data-center contract with Nscale

items.headline: OpenAI pledges to pay full power and infrastructure costs at sites it owns and to stop signing NDAs with public officials
items.why: It is an attempt to buy local consent after voters backed data-center limits in 40 of 41 ballot measures, though the pledge has no enforcement mechanism and excludes partner-built campuses.
